name: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells yarn-dyed fabrics as well as shirts and garments in Mainland China, Japan, South Korea, rest of Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It provides combed cotton blended yarns; yarns and fabrics of cotton, fiber, silk, wool, chemical fiber, and other materials; shirts; and dyeing fabrics, such as non-iron, white, multi-component, digital printing, stretch, and pant fabrics. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Zibo, the People's Republic of China.
